title: Add a check for fetching values twice, part 1
description:
This change only looks at calls to tvb_get_ntohl() - have fixed some issues but 30 detected issues remain.

Future MRs will:

* fix remaining detected issues
* expand to signed and little-endian 32-bit values
* check 64-bit values
* consider adding APIs to make it easier to extract 8 and 16-bit values, and also check for those

notes.body: Awesome feature!  Did you only update a few dissectors for testing?  I thought this would have caught 100s of results.

I fixed a couple more, but still around 570 flagged.

Note also that these are the most obvious ones, where the variable assigned to matches exactly the last part of the hf item name - there are doubtless others where the name isn't quite the same.

The usual downside to making this change is that the type of the variable wants to be uint32_t, rather than the natural size of the field.  I prefer to make the field uint32_t, but this can cause issues too (see the packet-ancp.c example that I added to this MR).

> The usual downside to making this change is that the type of the variable wants to be uint32_t,

Or, rather, *has* to be with `proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint()`.

> rather than the natural size of the field.

If the latter makes sense, we could add `proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint8()`, `proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint16()`, etc..

For now, this change will only look at calls to tvb_get_ntohl() - have fixed some issues but 30 detected issues remain.

Future MRs will:
- fix remaining detected issues
- expand to signed and little-endian 32-bit values
- check 64-bit values
- consider adding APIs to make it easier to extract 8 and 16-bit values, and also check for those

Ruff doesn't like using `l`. And it maybe could be simplified as follows:
```suggestion:-0+0
    contents = '\n'.join(line for line in lines if line.strip())
```

suggestions.from_content: contents = '\n'.join(l for l in lines if len(l.strip()) > 0)
suggestions.to_content: contents = '\n'.join(line for line in lines if line.strip())

+def check_double_fetches(filename, contents, items, result):
+    lines = contents.splitlines()
+    contents = '\n'.join(line for line in lines if line.strip())
+
+    line_re = r'([a-zA-Z0-9_= ;\(\)\+\"\-\{\}\*\,\&\+\[\]\!]*?)\n'
+
+    # Look for all calls in this file - note line before and after item added
+    matches = re.finditer(r'\n' + line_re +
+                          r'([\sa-z_\*=]*?)(proto_tree_add_item)\s*\(([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*,\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_]+).*?\)\;\s*\n' +
+                          line_re,
+                          contents, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
+
+    for m in matches:
+        full_hf_name = m.group(5)
+        hf_name = m.group(5).split('_')[-1]
+
+        prev_line = m.group(1)
+        prev_line_tokens = prev_line.strip().split(' ')
+
+        next_line = m.group(6)
+        next_line_tokens = next_line.strip().split(' ')
+
+        first_prev_token = prev_line_tokens[0]
+        first_next_token = next_line_tokens[0]
+
+        mask_value = 'unknown'
+        if full_hf_name in items:
+            mask_value = items[full_hf_name].mask_value
+
+        # TODO: verify same value of offset for both calls?
+
+        if 'tvb_get_ntohl' in prev_line and hf_name.endswith(first_prev_token) and '=' in prev_line_tokens:
+            result.warn(filename, 'PREV: val=', first_prev_token, 'hfname=', hf_name, 'mask=', mask_value, '- use proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint() ?\n',
+                        m.group(0))
+        elif 'tvb_get_ntohl' in next_line and hf_name.endswith(first_next_token) and '=' in next_line_tokens:
+            result.warn(filename, 'NEXT: val=', first_next_token, 'hfname=', hf_name, 'mask=', mask_value,  '- use proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint() ?\n',
+                        m.group(0))
+
